metadata.description: Short environment name (e.g. dev, demo). Used as a token in resource names.
Foundry/AI region (some model SKUs are region-restricted).
Model name to deploy in Foundry, e.g. gpt-4o-mini.
Capacity (TPM in thousands) for the model deployment.
Whether the tools container app already exists (set by preprovision hook).
Whether the api container app already exists (set by preprovision hook).
Whether the frontend container app already exists (set by preprovision hook).
Principal id of the user-assigned MI that should pull images.
Principal id of the MI that needs Azure AI User on the project.
azd service tag name (api / tools / frontend).

Whether this container app already exists. When true, reuse the deployed image and enable probes; when false, use a placeholder so first-time provision succeeds before azd deploy pushes the real image.

variables.probes: [if(parameters('exists'), createArray(createObject('type', 'Liveness', 'httpGet', createObject('path', '/healthz', 'port', parameters('targetPort')), 'initialDelaySeconds', 5, 'periodSeconds', 30), createObject('type', 'Readiness', 'httpGet', createObject('path', if(equals(parameters('serviceName'), 'frontend'), '/healthz', '/readyz'), 'port', parameters('targetPort')), 'initialDelaySeconds', 3, 'periodSeconds', 10)), createArray())]
